title: The Return of Christ
definition: The return of Christ is the future, visible, personal, and glorious coming of Jesus Christ to judge the living and the dead and bring God's redemptive plan to completion.
summary: Christ will return as Lord, King, and Judge. The Christian hope is not in speculation or date-setting, but in the Lord Himself.
christFocus: The Christian's hope is centered on the return of Jesus Christ, who will make all things right.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Christ will return as Lord, King, and Judge. The Christian hope is not in speculation or date-setting, but in the Lord Himself.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, understand Scripture clearly, and live with hope, obedience, and discernment.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, bring it into prayer, compare it with Scripture, and let it shape your worship, obedience, endurance, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
